title: Improper Control of Filename for Include/Require Statement in PHP Program ('PHP Remote File… (CVE-2026-129019)
description: CVE-2026-129019 is a vulnerability in Magepeople inc. Car Rental Manager up to version 1.5.5 that allows improper control of filenames used in PHP include/require statements, leading to PHP Local File Inclusion. This flaw can enable an attacker with low privileges to include local files, potentially exposing sensitive information. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level.
